Mesh Voxelization - Geeks3D
Voxel, voxelizer, voxelize, voxelized, voxelization… Yesterday I stumbled upon a tweet about a header only mesh voxelizer library in C. This library creates a voxelized mesh from a triangular mesh. It's really simple to use and I decided to add it to GeeXLab (in v0.12..0). This voxelization library does not perform deep voxelization (voxels inside of the mesh), only shell voxelization ...
